meta.author: claude
meta.description: Stone wall, walk stairs, level 1 of 3: shell and fittings (what soldiers build first). Over budget: 81 blocks vs 60. A straight module with a stone stair flight on the town side up to the walk. Merlons tile across joints: half merlon, crenel, merlon, crenel, merlon (the next module starts with its half merlon).
meta.changes: Quality check round 1: the merlon pattern changed across the whole set so modules tile end to end (a cobblestone-slab half merlon at x 0, merlons at x 2 and 4: neighbours now alternate high / low instead of two merlons side by side). The L2 torch moved onto the merlon at x 2; the slab that half-filled a crenel in L3 is removed.
